answer_1.quote: we tasked candidate models with generating explanations for memes from this dataset. We employ a zero-shot setting, prompting the candidate language models to explain the meaning of a given Internet meme, provide its origin (if available), and construct an example sentence.
answer_1.outputs: explanations of meme meaning, origin, and example sentences

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation was conducted on the entire dataset, wherein LLM-generated interpretations of meme meaning and origin were systematically compared against the ground truth. We adopted the following metrics: cosine similarity, BERTScore, and BARTScore.

answer_4.quote: To provide a more comprehensive and accurate assessment of the candidate models' performance... we conducted a human evaluation. We recruited individuals to rate the content generated by the language models.
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluated using a 3-point Likert scale (Disagree, Neutral, Agree) on statements assessing accuracy of meaning, origin, and example usage.
